metadata.description: This typed itinerary headed “Upham Itinerary” lists stays in Yokohama and Japan, Manila, Singapore, Calcutta, Bombay, Cairo, and Naples and Italy. It provides American Express Company mailing addresses and corresponding mailing-date ranges from Oxford, Ohio, for the listed locations.
metadata.title: Upham itinerary, undated
